delete o from dy_audience_v2_opportunity o join dy_audience_v2_live_session s on s.id=o.session_id where s.room_name_key=#{roomNameKey}

mapper.sql:
select e.customer_id customerId, cast(substring_index(group_concat(e.session_id order by e.occurred_at desc,e.id desc),',',1) as unsigned) sessionId, max(e.occurred_at) lastInteractionAt,count(e.id) interactionCount, sum(case when e.event_type='COMMENT' then 1 else 0 end) commentCount, case when sum(case when e.event_type='COMMENT' then 1 else 0 end)>0 then 'COMMENT' else 'VIEWER' end interactionType, case when sum(case when e.source_type='PLUGIN_REALTIME' then 1 else 0 end)>0 then 'PLUGIN' else 'MANUAL' end sourceType from dy_audience_v2_interaction_event e
force index (idx_av2_event_session_time_customer) force index (idx_av2_event_time_customer)
where e.occurred_at>=date_sub(current_date,interval 1 day) and e.session_id=#{sessionId} and e.occurred_at>=concat(#{beginDate},' 00:00:00') and e.occurred_at<date_add(#{endDate},interval 1 day) group by e.customer_id having commentCount>0 having commentCount=0
mapper.select:
select /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(5000) */ count(*) from (
select aggregate.customerId from () aggregate join dy_audience_v2_customer c on c.id=aggregate.customerId
limit 10001
select c.id from dy_audience_v2_interaction_event ce force index (idx_av2_event_type_time_customer) join dy_audience_v2_customer c on c.id=ce.customer_id
group by c.id order by max(ce.occurred_at) desc,c.id desc limit 10001
select c.id from dy_audience_v2_customer c
order by c.updated_at desc,c.id desc limit 10001
select c.id from dy_audience_v2_customer c join dy_audience_v2_interaction_event e on e.customer_id=c.id
group by c.id limit 10001
) capped

select c.id,c.display_name displayName,c.nickname_key nicknameKey,c.consult_stage stage,c.owner_user_id ownerUserId,c.owner_name ownerName from dy_audience_v2_customer c join dy_audience_v2_identity i on i.customer_id=c.id where i.sec_uid=#{secUid} limit 1

select id,display_name displayName,nickname_key nicknameKey,consult_stage stage,owner_user_id ownerUserId,owner_name ownerName from dy_audience_v2_customer where nickname_key=#{nicknameKey} order by id limit 1

select c.id customerId,c.display_name nickname,c.douyin_account douyinAccount, c.phone,c.wechat,c.owner_user_id ownerUserId, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),c.owner_name) ownerName from dy_audience_v2_customer c left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.owner_user_id where c.display_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.douyin_account like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.phone like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.wechat like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') order by case when c.display_name=#{keyword} then 0 when c.display_name like concat(#{keyword},'%') then 1 else 2 end, c.updated_at desc,c.id desc limit #{limit}

select id,customer_id customerId,sec_uid secUid from dy_audience_v2_identity where customer_id=#{customerId} and ((#{secUid} is not null and sec_uid=#{secUid}) or (#{secUid} is null and sec_uid is null and nickname_key=#{nicknameKey})) order by id limit 1
select count(distinct sec_uid) from dy_audience_v2_identity where customer_id=#{customerId} and sec_uid is not null and sec_uid!=''
mapper.update: update dy_audience_v2_identity set same_name_multi_identity=1 where customer_id=#{customerId}

update dy_audience_v2_customer set display_name=coalesce(#{displayName},display_name), consult_stage=coalesce(#{stage},consult_stage), interaction_status=case when #{interactionStatus} is null then interaction_status when interaction_status='BUY_INTENT' then interaction_status when interaction_status='HAS_COMMENT' and #{interactionStatus}='HAS_INTERACTION' then interaction_status else #{interactionStatus} end, fan_status=coalesce(#{fanStatus},fan_status), douyin_account=coalesce(#{douyinAccount},douyin_account), phone=coalesce(#{phone},phone), wechat=coalesce(#{wechat},wechat), owner_user_id=coalesce(#{ownerUserId},owner_user_id), owner_name=coalesce(#{ownerName},owner_name), updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select c.id, coalesce(c.owner_user_id,(select o.owner_user_id from dy_audience_v2_opportunity o where o.customer_id=c.id and o.owner_user_id is not null and o.status not in ('RELEASED','COMPLETED') order by o.id desc limit 1)) ownerUserId, coalesce((select nullif(u.nick_name,'') from sys_user u where u.user_id=coalesce(c.owner_user_id, (select o.owner_user_id from dy_audience_v2_opportunity o where o.customer_id=c.id and o.owner_user_id is not null and o.status not in ('RELEASED','COMPLETED') order by o.id desc limit 1)) limit 1),c.owner_name,(select o.owner_name from dy_audience_v2_opportunity o where o.customer_id=c.id and o.owner_user_id is not null and o.status not in ('RELEASED','COMPLETED') order by o.id desc limit 1)) ownerName from dy_audience_v2_customer c where c.id=#{customerId} for update
mapper.update: update dy_audience_v2_customer set owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId},owner_name=#{ownerName},updated_at=now() where id=#{customerId} and owner_user_id is null and not exists(select 1 from dy_audience_v2_opportunity o where o.customer_id=#{customerId} and o.owner_user_id is not null and o.status not in ('RELEASED','COMPLETED'))
update dy_audience_v2_opportunity set owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId},owner_name=#{ownerName},updated_at=now() where customer_id=#{customerId} and status not in ('RELEASED','COMPLETED')

update dy_audience_v2_followup_task t join dy_audience_v2_opportunity o on o.id=t.opportunity_id set t.assignee_user_id=#{ownerUserId},t.assignee_name=#{ownerName},t.updated_at=now() where o.customer_id=#{customerId} and t.status not in ('DONE','RELEASED') and t.task_type!='PHONE_SERVICE'
update dy_audience_v2_customer c join dy_audience_v2_opportunity o on o.customer_id=c.id set c.owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId},c.owner_name=#{ownerName},c.updated_at=now() where o.id=#{opportunityId}

select e.id,e.session_id sessionId,e.event_type eventType,e.content,e.occurred_at occurredAt,e.source_type sourceType,e.payload_json payloadJson,s.room_name roomName,s.live_date liveDate,coalesce(wp.watch_seconds,0) watchSeconds from dy_audience_v2_interaction_event e left join dy_audience_v2_live_session s on s.id=e.session_id left join (select session_id,customer_id,least(max(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(payload_json,'$.watchSeconds')) as unsigned)),21600) watch_seconds from dy_audience_v2_interaction_event where customer_id=#{customerId} and event_type='VIEWER' and json_valid(payload_json) and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(payload_json,'$.watchSeconds')) as unsigned)>=300 group by session_id,customer_id) wp on wp.customer_id=e.customer_id and wp.session_id=e.session_id where e.customer_id=#{customerId} order by e.occurred_at desc,e.id desc limit 100

select t.id,t.task_date taskDate,t.task_type taskType,t.assignee_user_id assigneeUserId,coalesce(nullif(au.nick_name,''),t.assignee_name) assigneeName,t.handoff_reason handoffReason,case when t.status='PENDING' and t.task_date<cast(convert_tz(now(),'+00:00','+08:00') as date) then 'OVERDUE' else t.status end status,o.consult_stage stage,o.consult_model consultModel,coalesce(nullif(ou.nick_name,''),c.owner_name,o.owner_name) ownerName,c.display_name nickname,c.id customerId,o.session_id sessionId from dy_audience_v2_followup_task t join dy_audience_v2_opportunity o on o.id=t.opportunity_id join dy_audience_v2_customer c on c.id=o.customer_id left join sys_user au on au.user_id=t.assignee_user_id left join sys_user ou on ou.user_id=coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) where t.status not in ('DONE','RELEASED') order by (t.task_date<cast(convert_tz(now(),'+00:00','+08:00') as date)) desc,t.task_date,t.id limit #{offset},#{limit}

with recent as ( select session_id,max(id) batchId from dy_audience_v2_ingest_batch group by session_id order by batchId desc limit #{offset},#{limit} ), daily as ( select x.session_id,date(x.created_at) uploadDay, coalesce(sum(x.accepted_count),0) dayAccepted, coalesce(sum(x.event_count),0) dayReceived, max(x.created_at) dayLastUpload from recent r join dy_audience_v2_ingest_batch latest on latest.id=r.batchId join dy_audience_v2_ingest_batch x force index (idx_av2_batch_session_created) on x.session_id=r.session_id and x.created_at>=date(latest.created_at) and x.created_at<date_add(date(latest.created_at),interval 1 day) group by x.session_id,date(x.created_at) ) select b.*,s.room_name,s.live_date,d.dayAccepted,d.dayReceived,d.dayLastUpload from recent r join dy_audience_v2_ingest_batch b on b.id=r.batchId join dy_audience_v2_live_session s on s.id=b.session_id left join daily d on d.session_id=b.session_id and d.uploadDay=date(b.created_at) order by b.id desc
